summary: We are seeking a motivated Front End Developer to join our remote team. This position is ideal for freshers with 0 to 1 year of relevant work experience.
responsibilities: Collaborate with the design and development team to create intuitive, user-friendly interfaces.
Develop robust, scalable front-end applications using React.js and Next.js frameworks.
Optimize the performance of front-end applications for maximum speed and scalability.
Implement responsive design principles to ensure applications work seamlessly across devices.
Integrate supabase and Firebase services for enhanced application functionalities.
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to other team members.
Stay updated on emerging front-end development trends and best practices.
Continuously improve application standards and contribute to overall team goals.
required_skills: TypeScript, with the ability to write clean, efficient code
Experience with Next.js, including server-side rendering and building dynamic web applications
Understanding of supabase for database management and real-time capabilities
Strong knowledge of React.js, including component life cycles and hooks for state management
Experience with Firebase services, including authentication, database, and cloud functions
Ability to work collaboratively in a remote team environment and communicate effectively
qualifications: Basic knowledge of version control systems like Git for efficient code management
